cancel.a: The extras end with the membership, and your account goes back to the free limit of {count} API requests a month. A custom theme you made is kept, and comes back if you join again.

personal.q: Can I share my API limit?
personal.a: No. The limit is per person and for your own personal use.

apps.q: I am building an app for other people. Does my tier cover them?
apps.a: No. Each reader of your app needs their own API key. See Third-Party Integrations in the {terms}.

oneAccount.q: Can one Patreon account unlock several Nadeshiko accounts?
oneAccount.a: No. One Patreon account links to one Nadeshiko account.

activate.q: How do I activate my perks after joining on Patreon?
activate.a: Join on Patreon, then sign in to Nadeshiko and link your Patreon account in Settings → Connections. Your perks and higher limits unlock right away.

freeStaysFree.a: Yes. Searching, mining to Anki, and everything currently free on Nadeshiko stays free. Supporter perks fund servers and ongoing development.

donations.q: Do Ko-fi or GitHub Sponsors donations unlock perks?
donations.a: No. Ko-fi and GitHub Sponsors are donation-only. Membership perks and higher limits are linked through Patreon.

boostRollover.q: Do unused request boosts roll over to the next month?
boostRollover.a: No. Your monthly request boosts reset on the 1st of each month (UTC).

how.title: How requests work
how.vote: Anyone with an account can request titles and vote. Each vote counts once, and asking for a title that is already requested adds your vote to it.
how.boost: Patrons get boosts every month: 3 for Seed, 5 for Flower and 10 for Nadeshiko. A boost counts as five votes.
how.limits: You can have 10 open requests at a time (30 for patrons) and file up to 5 a day.
how.news: We email you when a title you voted for is being worked on and when it is released. You can turn this off in your settings.
